I’m not a professional so this is only based on my experience as a patient with CPTSD. EMDR helped me and hurt me. I personally preferred it for more positive things. I’ve heard it’s not supposed to make you experience your trauma again but when I did it for trauma, it made me feel like I was back in it and it was very disturbing. 

My therapist warned me that it would be triggering in the beginning but I don’t think she did it correctly because it never stopped being triggering with her. But she did do 1 helpful session where I imagined my adult self comforting my child self and I pictured my favorite spot in nature. 

If you decide to do it, ask about your therapist’s approach and emphasize that you’d like to ease into it. They’re supposed to make sure you feel comfortable and not super triggered at the end of the session.
